name: Clarice Olden
original_name: クラリス・オールデン
source:
[i]"...I told you already. What I say goes."[/i]

[i]Loving Sister[/i]

Zephyr's older sister, a Lab researcher, and a strong-willed beauty. Since she just wishes her brother and the heroine would start dating already, she can't help but be nosy.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=clarice]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
